newsitem.title: USA: US junk bond fund new cash flows surge to $760 mln.
newsitem.headline: US junk bond fund new cash flows surge to $760 mln.

text.p: Net cash inflows into U.S. high-yield mutual funds increased to $760.2 million for the week ended April 30, continuing to rise for the third consecutive week, according to AMG Data Services.
This week's number showed that in the past three weeks, investors have replaced much of the money they removed from the junk bond market during late March and early April.

According to AMG, a total of $1.32 billion in new cash has poured into the high-yield market since the week ended April 16. The market experienced around $1.58 billion of net cash outflows in the prior four weeks, according to AMG's data.
The figures represent flows from high-yield mutual funds that report on a weekly basis.
AMG, based in Arcata, Calif., is a U.S. mutual fund information company.
